title: WildTrace: the open atlas of illegal wildlife trade
description: An open-source map of the global illegal wildlife trade in fauna and flora: seizures, arrests and convictions from public reports, each case graded by the strength of its evidence (validated, official, corroborated, single report), with an in-browser link-analysis workbench. The archived release includes the pipeline code (MIT) and the published data in web/data/: case data CC BY 4.0; CITES-derived flows (flows*.json, cites_*_flows.csv) under the CITES Trade Database terms (non-commercial, with attribution: CITES Trade Database, compiled by UNEP-WCMC for the CITES Secretariat); VIRION-derived virus counts (zoonoses.json, species_viruses.csv) ODbL 1.0 (Carlson et al. 2022, mBio 13(2): e02985-21). No person accused is named.
notes: Code MIT. Case data (cases.*) CC BY 4.0. CITES-derived files (flows*.json, cites_*_flows.csv) are NOT CC BY: CITES Trade Database terms apply (non-commercial, with attribution). VIRION-derived files (zoonoses.json, species_viruses.csv) ODbL 1.0.
